prompt: An Entra user signs in successfully but an Azure Storage data operation is forbidden after a subscription migration. Diagnose safely.
directAnswer: Bind tenant, principal object ID, token audience without exposing the token, action/data action, resource ID, subscription, timestamp and correlation ID. Authentication succeeded; now inspect role definitions and assignments at resource, resource-group, subscription and management-group scopes, group inheritance, conditions or deny assignments, Policy effects, Storage data-plane roles, network/private-endpoint context and service logs. Do not grant Owner. Correct the narrowest reviewed assignment, test the intended data operation and an intended denial, then record and reconcile the change.
foundation: Azure authorization combines principal, role and scope, while Policy and service data-plane controls answer different questions.
reasoningSteps: Separate management actions from data actions.
Inspect deny condition Policy and network context.
seniorAnswer: I preserve the failing correlation and refuse subscription-wide Owner because it widens blast radius and may not supply the required Storage data action.
weakAnswer: The login works, so grant Owner on the subscription and regenerate a client secret.
whyWeak: Owner is broad, a human login needs no new workload secret, and Storage data access, deny, Policy or network context may still differ.

evidence.signal: tenant principal audience resource and correlation
